# Siemens DCA-510 Driver

**Author:** Siemens AG<br/>
**Platforms:** x10/x25 (HIGOLD), x35/x45/x55 (EGOLD), x65/x75 (SGOLD), ODM, BREW

This driver is intended for the Siemens DCA-510 USB cable and creates a
virtual serial COM port in the system. The package includes an installer and separate
drivers 1.5.0.0 for Windows 98/ME and 1.5.0.5 for Windows 2000/XP, as well as
an uninstaller.
